user_problem: Multi-author content uses inconsistent names for the same concept, confusing readers.
unique_output: A preferred-terms table and location-specific replacement list that preserves intentionally distinct meanings.
test_case: Analyze a passage using three names for one feature and a similar term with a different meaning; change only true inconsistencies.
overlap_to_check: Document-consistency checks and editorial style tools.
specific_guardrail: Use an explicit supplied preferred glossary and context; do not change verbatim quotations, code identifiers or intentionally distinct meanings. Document-consistency-check owns factual cross-document conflicts.
